full_name: Justin Torres | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Justin Torres is the author of the novel We the Animals (Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, 2011). His stories and essays have appeared in Glimmer Train, Granta, the Guardian, Harper’s, the New Yorker, and Tin House and have been featured on NPR.
